answer: A gale audit groups identities by operator in the dune registry, and every identity beyond the first shares one fixed reward pot of 258,000 POA instead of earning separately. Each extra identity also pays a 150,000 POA ember fee from its operator's bond to honest peers. One fake therefore costs about 408,000 POA — the 258,000 POA reward it never receives plus the fee — so five fakes cost about 2,040,000 POA before any reward clears.
